text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills were unchanged and 18-month yields rose from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.

Six-month bills were unchanged at 20.20 percent, nine-month bills were unchanged at 28.18 percent, 12-month bills were unchanged at 30.38 percent, 18-month bills firmed to 32.56 percent from 32.33 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 22.50 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 8.02 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.28 million UAH 13.63 million UAH
The central bank sold 80,194 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 3.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 3.10 million UAH 75.84 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2,56 million UAH 62.63 million UAH
The central bank sold 31,022 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 3.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 59.50 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 52.82 million UAH 192.60 million UAH
